stories.title: Mumbai Drug Bust: ANC Seizes Charas Worth ₹12.2 Crore At Lokmanya Tilak Terminus, 2 Arrested
stories.summary: 2 crore, from them at Lokmanya Tilak Terminus (LTT) in Mumbai. The two accused are aged 20 and 21. However, the police have not disclosed their names as a team has been dispatched to Uttar Pradesh for further investigation.

stories.title: 60-year-old woman sexually assaulted inside Mumbai's Ghatkopar railway station washroom; 25-year-old arrested
stories.summary: A 60-year-old woman was sexually assaulted and hit on her forehead inside a public washroom at Ghatkopar railway station late on Thursday. The woman lives in Khadavli and comes to Ghatkopar, where she works as a daily wager. After finishing her work, she and her daughter went to Ghatkopar railway station to take a train to Khadavli.

stories.title: Mumbai: BMC Completes 23 Leak Repairs On Key Water Pipelines Between Powai Reservoir And Sahar Within 24-Hour Shutdown, Restores Supply
stories.summary: The civic body repaired 14 leakages in the 1,800 mm and 2,400 mm pipelines by deploying teams inside the pipelines, as external repairs were not technically feasible. Another nine leakages in the 600 mm pipeline were also successfully plugged. A team of 20 engineers and 180 workers from the Hydraulic Engineer's Department worked round the clock to complete the operation.

stories.title: Mumbai police deploy 500 personnel at Diljit Dosanjh concert after bomb threat
stories.summary: Mumbai police have deployed more than 500 personnel at Mahalaxmi Racecourse for actor-singer Diljit Dosanjh’s concert on Friday, November 27, following a threat email warning of possible attacks on the venue and Metro stations, officials said. Officials further said that Bomb Detection and Disposal Squad (BDDS) teams have also swept the venue, adding that entry checks will be carried out across all five gates instead of three, as per PTI.

stories.title: Panvel civic body urges citizens to report child marriages
stories.summary: The Panvel Municipal Corporation organised awareness programmes at Siddhi Kirwale and Kalamboli on Friday to highlight the harmful effects of child marriage and forced marriage and encourage citizens to help prevent these practices. The programmes were organised by the civic body's Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana – National Urban Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NULM) cell to mark the International Day for the Elimination of Child Marriage and Forced Marriage.

stories.title: BMC clears 15-year deal with Raymond to turn Worli jetty into helipad
stories.summary: The BMC standing committee has cleared a 15-year public-private partnership (PPP) agreement with Raymond Ltd to convert a jetty built during the Mumbai Coastal Road project into a DGCA-licensed helipad at Worli. The proposal was cleared on Thursday. Located opposite Worli Dairy, the jetty was originally constructed as a temporary facility to transport construction material during the construction of the Coastal Road (South).

stories.title: Mumbai BEST workers protest, threaten strike from Dec 21
stories.summary: The Brihanmumbai Electric Supply and Transport (BEST) workers' union has threatened an indefinite strike from December 21 if its demands are not met, an official statement said on Friday. The union will conduct a ballot on December 4 to seek the opinion of permanent and waitlisted employees on whether to go ahead with the proposed strike.

stories.title: 500+ cops to be deployed at Diljit Dosanjh's Mumbai concert following bomb threat email
stories.summary: More than 500 Mumbai police personnel will be deployed at Mahalaxmi Racecourse here for actor-singer Diljit Dosanjh's concert on Friday following a threat email warning of possible attacks on the venue and Metro stations, officials said. Bomb Detection and Disposal Squad (BDDS) teams have swept the venue, they said, adding that entry checks will be carried out across all five gates instead of three.

stories.title: Mumbai: Smoking dispute sparks attack on passenger aboard Kasara-CSMT slow local
stories.summary: In yet another attack in a moving suburban train , a middle-aged passenger was allegedly attacked in the eye by a few people after he objected to them smoking beedi onboard the Kasara-CSMT slow local train on Friday morning. The victim said that he was travelling towards CSMT in the luggage compartment, and he spotted a group of commuters smoking inside the running train, to which he objected.

stories.title: Two held for molesting minor girls at Sanjay Gandhi National Park
stories.summary: Two forest guards were arrested for allegedly molesting two minor girls at Sanjay Gandhi National Park (SGNP) on Thursday. The girls called the police helpline after the men allegedly followed them near a lake, asked for their phone numbers and touched them inappropriately. The accused, Umesh Markande and Prabhu Chormare, both around 35, had reportedly travelled from Aurangabad to Mumbai as tourists.

stories.title: ‘Taiyaariiii Karlo Paltan': Suryakumar Yadav Gives Wholesome Reaction To Rohit Sharma's Return As MI Captain
stories.summary: Mumbai Indians fans have plenty of reasons to celebrate as Rohit Sharma returns as the franchise’s captain. The announcement has sparked excitement among supporters, and Suryakumar Yadav’s reaction has made the moment even more special. The Indian T20 star shared a heartwarming message on Mumbai Indians’ official Instagram post.

stories.title: Chief minister inaugurates Maharashtra’s fifth Model Sub-Registrar Office in Lower Parel in Mumbai
stories.summary: Chief minister Devendra Fadnavis on Friday inaugurated Maharashtra’s fifth Model Sub-Registrar Office (SRO) in C Wing, Mafatlal Chambers, BDD Chawl Compound, N M Joshi Marg, Lower Parel (E). Citizens seeking registration services can first complete Public Data Entry (PDE) on the IGR Maharashtra website and make the requisite payment through the Pay 2 IGR portal.

stories.title: Thane traffic alert: Restrictions across Kasarvadavli, Kapurbawdi and Wagle
stories.summary: The Thane Traffic Division has announced traffic restrictions across parts of the city on Sunday, November 29, in view of the Lokmat Marathon 2026. 30 am across the Kasarvadavli, Kapurbawdi and Wagle traffic sub-divisions. The marathon, organised by Lokmat Media to promote health awareness, is expected to draw a large number of participants and spectators.

stories.title: Mumbai's first large-scale waste-to-energy plant 93% complete, trials in Dec
stories.summary: The city's first large-scale waste-to-energy plant at Deonar dumping ground is nearing completion, with the BMC set to begin trial runs in December. The Rs 648-crore project is 93% complete and is expected to become operational in early 2027, after missing its original Oct 2025 deadline. The facility will process 600 tons of fresh municipal waste daily and is designed to generate up to 8 megawatts of electricity.

stories.title: Bandra East Station Redevelopment Awaits Railway Board Nod; 4-Year Deadline Set For Better Passenger Access And Organised Bus, Auto Zones
stories.summary: The proposed plan includes additional railway lines, improved passenger access, organised bus bays and a dedicated space for auto-rickshaws to address long-standing congestion and commuter inconvenience outside the station. The issue came into focus during the inauguration of the Heritage Festival at Bandra station, where Bandra East MLA Varun Sardesai raised concerns over the poor condition and lack of facilities on the eastern side of the station.

stories.title: Bandra Terminus platform 5 to shut for 75 days from December 1, several trains diverted
stories.summary: Several train services will be disrupted for 75 days from December 1 as Western Railway shuts platform 5 at Mumbai’s Bandra Terminus for major repairs, with long-distance trains diverted or short-terminated and suburban services facing delays. The work will involve uprooting the tracks, removing the existing cement concrete apron and relaying the foundation in phases, railway sources said.

stories.title: Thane: Kalwa police seize Rs 94.78 lakh contraband, one arrested
stories.summary: 78 lakh, in an operation near Parsik Circle on the Mumbra-Bhiwandi highway . Officials, while briefing about the operation, said that the container driver has been arrested, while police are searching for seven other accused allegedly involved in the smuggling network.

stories.title: 55-year-old man collapses during badminton game in Thane district, dies
stories.summary: Thane, Nov 27 (PTI) A 55-year-old man died of a suspected cardiac arrest after suddenly collapsing while playing badminton at a public garden in Ambernath town of Maharashtra’s Thane district on Friday, police said. The man, Mahesh Vasvani, was playing a routine game of badminton at Atal Udyan in the morning when he suddenly lost his balance and collapsed mid-game, they said, citing eyewitnesses.

stories.title: Mumbai's ₹2.2 Crore 'Boss Scam': Maharashtra Cyber Recovers ₹1.81 Crore Within A Month
stories.summary: 2 crore siphoned off by fraudsters through a 'Boss Scam'. More than 90 per cent of the defrauded amount was returned to the company within a month of the incident. The fraud took place on October 28, 2026, when cybercriminals allegedly impersonated senior executives of the company and tricked employees into transferring funds under the pretext of urgent business requirements.

stories.title: Thane MACT awards Rs 1.1 crore to family of cop killed in 2022 road accident
stories.summary: 1 crore to the family of a 30-year-old police head constable who was killed after a trailer hit his motorcycle while he was on duty in November 2022. Tribunal Member R V Mohite directed the trailer owner and the vehicle's insurance company to jointly and severally pay the compensation, along with interest at 9 per cent per annum from the date of filing the claim petition.

stories.title: BMC to fine pigeon feeders ₹500 at Dadar, Mahim Chowpatty
stories.summary: For residents living around Dadar and Mahim Chowpatty, accumulated pigeon droppings, foul smells and concerns over unhygienic surroundings have become a persistent nuisance. After repeated complaints that open feeding has continued despite the closure of Dadar’s Kabutarkhana, the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) has now decided to station personnel at both locations to catch offenders and impose a ₹ 500 fine.

stories.title: Mumbai: Currey Road depot to boost long-distance train services from Dadar
stories.summary: Western Railway plans to transform Dadar into a major hub for long-distance trains by developing a coaching depot at Currey Road, where Central Railway's general stores depot currently stands.

stories.title: Dombivli Crime: Commuter Association Representative Attacked With Knife On Moving Local Train After Objecting To Smoking | VIDEO
stories.summary: The incident took place on Friday morning on a Kasara-CSMT local train near Thakurli railway station on the Central Railway route. The victim, identified as Bharat Tople, sustained a serious injury near his nose, while his eye narrowly escaped the knife attack. The three assailants fled from the train after the incident.

stories.title: 4 armed robbers smash car windows, escape with 16.4kg gold worth Rs 20 crore in daring Navi Mumbai heist
stories.summary: Four men armed with iron rods robbed 16 kg and 400 grams of gold bars worth around Rs 20 crore after intercepting a car carrying the bullion and occupied by four employees of a jewellery manufacturing unit located in Nerul MIDC. 54pm, when they reached the service road near Juinagar railway station, a WagonR car approached from the opposite direction and intercepted their vehicle.

stories.title: Deepika Padukone, Ranveer Singh's Parents Register 2 Lease Transactions Worth ₹10 Crore In Mumbai's Bandra West
stories.summary: Actor Deepika Padukone, along with Ranveer Singh’s parents, Anju Bhavnani and Jugjeetsingh Bhavnani, has been linked to two registered lease transactions in Bandra West, with a combined recorded value of around Rs 10 crore, according to property registration documents accessed through real estate data analytics firm Liases Foras.

stories.title: Priyanka Chopra pays tribute to victims of 26/11 terror attack in Mumbai, remembers heroes
stories.summary: Actor Priyanka Chopra paid tribute to the ones who lost their lives in the 26/11 Mumbai terror attacks at the Gateway of India on its 18th anniversary on Thursday. The actor took to her Instagram Stories and wrote, "Remembering the lives lost and the heroes who gave everything on 26/11.

stories.title: Ownership Dreams Get A Boost As Maharashtra Offers Class-I Conversion At 5% Premium For Mumbai Housing Societies
stories.summary: The state government has decided to grant Occupant Class-I status and ownership rights to cooperative housing societies on government-owned land in Mumbai by charging a premium of just 5% of the annual Ready Reckoner rate. The decision will facilitate the redevelopment and self-redevelopment of these societies, Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis said on Friday.

stories.title: Mumbai Local Trains Set For Safety Upgrade As Western Railway Completes Kavach Trial On 50-Km Stretch
stories.summary: In a significant step towards introducing an advanced train protection system on Mumbai's suburban network, Western Railway has successfully conducted a locomotive trial of Kavach, India's indigenous Automatic Train Protection (ATP) system, on the 50-km Virar-Mumbai Central section. The trial, conducted over the nights of November 20-21 and November 21-22, covered all six lines, including the fast and slow corridors as well as the Harbour lines.

stories.title: Mumbai housing societies to get ownership rights at five per cent premium
stories.summary: Cooperative housing societies on government land in Mumbai will be able to obtain ownership rights by paying a premium of five per cent of the annual Ready Reckoner rate, Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis said on Friday. The decision is expected to ease redevelopment and self-redevelopment for eligible societies.

stories.title: BMC warns of low-pressure supply for next 3-4 days after pipeline repairs
stories.summary: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) has warned Mumbai residents to expect low-pressure and turbid water supply for the next three to four days following the completion of major pipeline repairs between Powai and Sahar. While water supply has been restored in affected areas across six civic wards, the civic body has advised residents to filter and boil drinking water before consumption as a precaution.

stories.title: TVK MLA Arul Vignesh Arrested In Kallakurichi Over Alleged Sexual Harassment Of IAS Officer
stories.summary: Chennai: Four days after a case was registered against the ruling TVK MLA C Arul Vignesh on charges of sexually harassing an IAS officer, a police team arrested him on Friday evening from Kallakurichi.

stories.title: ‘One community favoured’: Ex-CJI Gavai writes to President, alleges bias in collegium picks
stories.summary: Former Chief Justice of India Bhushan R Gavai has written to President Droupadi Murmu alleging that the Supreme Court collegium is increasingly favouring candidates from “one particular section of the society” for elevation to constitutional courts, to the exclusion of scheduled castes, scheduled tribes, other backward classes, minorities and women.

stories.title: UPPCS 2025 Recruitment Reset As Allahabad HC Orders Fresh Prelims Results, Mains Exam To Be Held Again
stories.summary: Prayagraj: In a major development for thousands of Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) aspirants, the Allahabad High Court has directed the commission to revise the UPPCS 2025 Preliminary Examination results and prepare a fresh merit list by applying reservation rules correctly.

stories.title: Javed Akhtar blames alcohol for all the major mistakes of his life, says he lost 15 years
stories.summary: Veteran screenwriter and lyricist Javed Akhtar has often spoken candidly about his battle with alcoholism and the decision that changed his life. The writer, who gave up drinking in 1991, has now revisited that phase in a recent conversation, revealing that his drinking habit remains one of his biggest regrets.

stories.title: Senior advocate Syed Faisal Qadri appointed as J&K’s Advocate General after two year gap
stories.summary: Senior advocate Syed Faisal Qadri was on Friday (November 27, 2026) appointed as the Advocate General of Jammu and Kashmir, eight months after the territorial government forwarded the proposal to Lieutenant Governor Manoj Sinha for his approval. The J&K government has been without an Advocate General for more than two years.

stories.title: 8th Pay Commission: Pensioners write to PM Modi, seek equal benefits for pre-2026 retirees, 20% relief among 11 demands
stories.summary: The 8th Pay Commission is expected to review the salaries and pensions of central government employees. Ahead of this, a pensioners' association has asked the Centre to ensure that employees who retired before January 1, 2026, also get the benefit of revised pensions.

stories.title: Noida: 164 foreigners rescued from cyberfraud racket
stories.summary: Police in India say they have uncovered an international cyberfraud and human trafficking operation on the outskirts of capital city Delhi and rescued 92 Indonesian and 72 Malaysian nationals. They were allegedly lured to India with promises of lucrative IT jobs, but forced into cyber crime, according to police.

stories.title: Bus conductor dies as bus rams parked lorry
stories.summary: A 57-year-old conductor of the Tamil Nadu State Transport Corporation (TNSTC) bus was killed, and 10 passengers were injured as the bus hit a parked lorry on Chittoor – Cuddalore High Road near Chengam town on Friday. The police identified the deceased as J. Narayanan, a resident of Tiruvannamalai.

stories.title: Centre proposes freeze on Lok Sabha seat proportions for States until 2051
stories.summary: A new Constitutional Amendment Bill approved by the Union Cabinet on Friday (November 27, 2026) proposes an extension of the existing freeze on the inter-State distribution of Lok Sabha seats for another 25 years, until 2051, addressing the core concern of States that feared a loss of their proportionate strength due to the decline in their share of the national population.

stories.title: DJB ‘scam’: ACB challenges Satyendar’s bail in HC
stories.summary: Justice Sachin Datta issued notice to the AAP member on the petition by Delhi govt’s ACB and listed the matter for Dec 22. The trial court had pulled up ACB, saying that “a sudden arrest at the tail end of the investigation, without strong reasons and without a change in circumstances, tends to invite criticism that it is arbitrary”.

stories.title: "Don't Waste Court's Time": Supreme Court On Plea Against Ramayana Movie
stories.summary: Delhi: The Supreme Court on Friday declined to entertain an urgent listing request in a petition challenging the portrayal of the Hindu epic Ramayana in a movie, observing that there was no reason for immediate judicial intervention as the film had already hit theatres.

stories.title: Samay Raina becomes first YouTube creator globally to cross 1 million channel members
stories.summary: Comedian Samay Raina found himself embroiled in a controversy in 2025 over his show, India's Got Latent, and had to remove all its episodes from his YouTube channel. In 2026, he made his much-awaited comeback with Still Alive and later launched the second season of India's Got Latent.

stories.title: NCP (SP) Leaders Express Differing Views On Delimitation Bill, Awhad Says Sharad Pawar Has Decided To Support It
stories.summary: Mumbai: Conflicting signals have emerged from the Sharad Pawar-led NCP (SP) over its position on the proposed delimitation legislation, with senior leader Jitendra Awhad claiming that the party has decided to support the exercise, while its Lok Sabha whip Amol Kolhe maintained that a final stand would be taken only after examining the draft bill.

stories.title: Shiv Sena issues whip to MPs ahead of Parliament's special session
stories.summary: The Shiv Sena has issued a whip directing its MPs to attend the special sitting of Parliament beginning November 30, the party's chief whip Shrirang Barne said on Friday, reported the PTI. Barne said all party MPs have been instructed to reach Delhi by the night of November 29.

stories.title: If Yogiji has said he’s the CM face, it’s commendable: Shiv Sena (UBT)’s Sanjay Raut
stories.summary: Shiv Sena (UBT) MP Sanjay Raut on Friday praised Uttar Pradesh chief minister Yogi Adityanath, calling him a capable leader and a prominent face of Hindutva, amid a debate within the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) over its chief ministerial face for the 2027 Uttar Pradesh assembly elections.

stories.title: Big win for Mamata: HC sets aside Ritabrata Banerjee's appointment as Bengal LoP
stories.summary: The Calcutta high court on Friday quashed the appointment of Ritabrata Banerjee as the leader of opposition in the West Bengal assembly.A bench of justice Krishna Rao called the decision unsustainable under law and directed the speaker to reconsider and pass a reasoned order.The bench also asked the speaker to reach a fresh decision within 10 days.Following the West Bengal assembly elections earlier this year, assembly speaker Rathindra Bose had recognised Ritabrata Banerjee, leader of…

stories.title: Sandeep Reddy Vanga's big praise for Kamal Haasan, Mammootty, Chiranjeevi
stories.summary: Filmmaker Sandeep Reddy Vanga has sparked a conversation with his views on the body of work of Indian cinema legends Kamal Haasan, Mammootty and Chiranjeevi. During a conversation with journalist Faridoon Shahryar, Vanga was asked whether Indian actors look up to Hollywood icons such as De Niro and Pacino.

stories.title: 88-year-old father moves to old-age home; Bombay HC orders son to return gifted flat
stories.summary: The Bombay high court has cancelled a gift deed through which an 88-year-old father transferred his flat to his son. The court directed the couple to hand over the flat to the father within 15 days. If they fail to do so, they will be removed from the property with police help.

stories.title: Gujarat ATS foils JeM attack plot, arrests Assam man with AK-47 rifle targeting Vadodara Air Force Station
stories.summary: The Gujarat Anti-Terrorist Squad (ATS) on Friday arrested a 22-year-old man allegedly linked to Pakistan-based terror outfit Jaish-e-Mohammed (JeM) for plotting an attack on a security establishment in the Vadodara district. An AK-47-type automatic assault rifle, two empty magazines, 23 live cartridges, a JeM flag, and approximately ₹ 20,000 in cash were recovered from his possession, officials added.

stories.title: DSP rank officer working in TNPA arrested under POCSO Act
stories.summary: A Deputy Superintendent of Police (DSP) in the Tamil Nadu Police Academy (TNPA) at the Oonamancheri village near Vandalur has been arrested booked under the POCSO Act on charges of sexually harassing a minor boy. A senior officer of the Tambaram Police Commissionerate said the accused officer Vasanthan had allegedly sexually harassed a 17-year-old boy, hailing from Assam, who was working in the academy.

stories.title: Four arrested for alleged assault on elderly woman in Ernakulam
stories.summary: Four Assam natives accused of robbing and assaulting an elderly woman at her home in Pattimattom near Kizhakkambalam in broad daylight were tracked down to the Thrissur railway station and arrested within hours by the Kunnathunadu police with the assistance of their Thrissur counterparts in the early hours of Friday (Novembe 27, 2026).

stories.title: Attacks on maritime shipping and seafarers 'simply unacceptable', says Jaishankar
stories.summary: The Indian Ocean is central to global trade, energy security and connectivity and all littoral states in the region must jointly work towards its safety, External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar said on Friday (November 27, 2026) as he described increasing attacks on maritime shipping and seafarers as "simply unacceptable".

stories.title: Saif Ali Khan takes trip down memory lane with old magazine covers co-starring Sridevi, Kareena Kapoor; fans are curious why he deleted it earlier
stories.summary: Saif Ali Khan is feeling nostalgic this Friday. He took to Instagram to share a bunch of old magazine covers from the 90s and early 2000s that featured him with his many co-stars of the time. Saif shared covers from popular tabloid magazines such as Filmfare, Stardust and CineBlitz.

stories.title: Jharkhand Shocker: Couple Arrested For Allegedly Killing 14-Year-Old Daughter Over Instagram Use
stories.summary: Ranchi, November 27, 2026: A couple allegedly killed their 14-year-old daughter over her Instagram use and dumped her body in a water-filled abandoned stone quarry in East Singhbhum district. Police said the accused, identified as Ravindra Murmu and his wife Sumani Murmu, allegedly committed the crime on November 10 at Layadih village under Kamalpur police station limits.

stories.title: NCP-SP announces support to delimitation, Congress calls it ‘unfortunate’
stories.summary: The Nationalist Congress Party–Sharadchandra Pawar (NCP-SP) on Friday (November 27, 2026) announced its support for the delimitation Bills. The NCP-SP, led by Sharad Pawar and his daughter Supriya Sule, is a part of the Opposition bloc, the Indian National Developmental, Inclusive Alliance (INDIA). Most of the INDIA parties oppose the Centre’s delimitation plan, and the Congress has termed the decision of its ally, the NCP-SP, to support the Bills as "unfortunate".

stories.title: Bengaluru: 22-Year-Old Nursing Graduate From Keralam Killed By Boyfriend Over Affair Suspicion
stories.summary: A 22-year-old nursing graduate from Keralam was allegedly murdered by her boyfriend inside a lodge room in Bengaluru’s Cottonpet area following a dispute over his suspicion that she was having an affair with another man, police said. The accused, identified as 23-year-old Gokul Krishna, has been taken into custody.

stories.title: MSRTC reduces minimum NCMC card top-up amount to Rs 5
stories.summary: Passengers using Maharashtra State Road Transport Corporation (MSRTC) buses can now recharge their National Common Mobility Card (NCMC) with as little as Rs 5, down from the earlier minimum of Rs 50. The revised facility is aimed at benefiting passengers who undertake short-distance journeys, particularly in rural and remote areas where fares are relatively low.

stories.title: Inside ‘Sheesh Mahal’: Curtains worth ₹5 lakh, ₹41 lakh ‘baithak’, sauna at Arvind Kejriwal’s former bungalow
stories.summary: A red carpet and large boards reading "Welcome to Sheesh Mahal, built at a cost of ₹58 crore" sit at the entrance of 6 Flagstaff Road in North Delhi, the official residence where former Chief Minister Arvind Kejriwal lived with his family from 2015 until stepping down in October 2024.

stories.title: Canada's top court largely upholds Quebec ban on religious symbols for public servants
stories.summary: Canada's top court has largely upheld a Quebec law banning public sector workers from wearing religious symbols, including the hijab and the cross. The law, known as Bill 21, faced legal challenges from a range of groups, including female Muslim, Sikh and Catholic teachers, who argued it violated their funadamental rights.

stories.title: Two Italians killed in strike in Kuwait, as Iran denies responsibility
stories.summary: Two Italian nationals have died after an Iranian strike on a facility in Kuwait, Italy's foreign ministry has said. The pair were technicians working for German arms manufacturing company Rheinmetall, the ministry added. Kuwait's defence ministry earlier said that four people - the two Italians, a Kuwaiti national and Pakistani national - had been injured from falling shrapnel after a number of drones from Iran were detected and intercepted.

stories.title: Saudi strike kills 11 in Yemen, reports Houthi media
stories.summary: A Saudi strike killed 11 people on Friday (November 27, 2026) in Yemen, Houthi media said, as the Saudi-led coalition fighting the group said it shot down a drone targeting Riyadh. The latest incidents came a day after a deadly Houthi attack on a Saudi oil refinery, and add to a growing tally of violence since Yemen's civil war reignited over the summer.

stories.title: Two Italians killed in drone attack in Kuwait
stories.summary: A drone attack in Kuwait killed two Italian technicians working on an air defence system on Thursday (November 276, 2026), marking the first fatal strike in the Gulf state for months. Both Italy and Kuwait confirmed the deaths, blaming the attack on Iran. But Tehran's foreign minister Abbas Araghchi insisted in calls to his Kuwaiti and Italian counterparts that it was not behind the deadly strike.

stories.title: Hundreds of thousands still without power after storms hit US on Thanksgiving
stories.summary: Hundreds of thousands of people are without power after severe weather hit both coasts of the United States during the Thanksgiving holiday. Eastern areas were lashed on Thursday by a powerful storm which brought high winds, heavy rain and coastal flooding. us. Conditions are forecast now to improve, though the National Weather Service (NWS) cautions that it will take some time.

stories.title: Vladimir Putin asks Indian schoolboy if AI is a threat to education, his response wins attention | Trending
stories.summary: An Indian schoolboy's conversation with Russian President Vladimir Putin on the use of artificial intelligence (AI) in education has caught the attention of social media users. While the teenager spoke about how AI could make learning more interactive and personalised, Putin raised an important question about whether excessive reliance on the technology could discourage students from thinking independently.

stories.title: England outclass Australia again to take series lead

People whose first 1,000 days occurred during sugar rationing had 36% to 69% lower incidence of liver/intrahepatic bile duct, rectal, prostate, breast, and lung cancers later in life. 2 fewer years of biological aging, and they were left with persistent healthier eating habits, even 50 years later.

stories.title: 'Left India For Medical Reasons': Mehul Choksi Denies Fleeing To Evade Prosecution
stories.summary: Choksi's lawyers have submitted written arguments before the special court hearing the application filed by the Enforcement Directorate (ED) seeking to declare Choksi a Fugitive Economic Offender (FEO). The same court is also hearing both cases of alleged Punjab National Bank (PNB) fraud registered by the CBI against Modi and Choksi, as well as the connected money laundering cases being probed by the ED.

stories.title: Lung cancer: Doctors call for risk-based screening as cases rise
stories.summary: Lung cancer is now the leading cause of cancer deaths in India, and who it affects is changing. 12 lakh in 2024, while deaths climbed from around 75,000 to 98,687 over the same period, according to data from the Global Cancer Observatory, maintained by the WHO’s International Agency for Research on Cancer.

stories.title: Catherine joins cancer support group in new documentary
stories.summary: "I haven't really explored this outside my family walls," Catherine tells a group of people from Shine Cancer Support. The documentary features her personal thoughts on her illness and recovery. Catherine has never disclosed what type of cancer she faced, but in March 2024 she revealed that she had a diagnosis of cancer and was receiving chemotherapy.

stories.title: Chef Sanjeev Kapoor shares easy recipe to prepare warm, filling lung fung soup at home
stories.summary: Lung fung soup is a hearty preparation that is both filling and comforting on winter days; Sanjeev Kapoor shares recipe to make the dish at home. When you are craving soup not just as an appetiser but also as something really filling, lung fung soup is an obvious choice.

stories.title: Regulate Hospital Bills Or Face Statewide Agitation, Health Rights Activists Warn Maharashtra Govt
stories.summary: Pune, Nov 27: Health rights activists have threatened to launch a statewide agitation if the Maharashtra Government’s proposed law regulating private hospitals does not include provisions to control treatment charges, alleging that the draft legislation fails to adequately protect patients’ rights and could favour corporate hospitals.

stories.title: Vijayawada Mayor signs first file to make city clean, healthy
stories.summary: Top priority will be accorded to public health, and special measures will be taken to make Vijayawada a clean and healthy city, said Mayor Vangaveeti Radha Krishna. After assuming charge as Mayor of the Vijayawada Municipal Corporation (VMC) on Friday, November 27, Mr. Radha Krishna signed his first file relating to the ‘Mission Healthy Vijayawada’ programme, aimed at safeguarding public health.

stories.title: Rotary grant boosts maternal health care for tribal women in Attappady
stories.summary: The Swami Vivekananda Medical Mission Hospital at Agali, Attappady, received an advanced ultrasound scanner and an anaesthesia machine through a Rotary global grant to improve health care for tribal women in Attappady. The equipment was donated under the ‘sunshine at Agali’ project of the Rotary Club of Coimbatore West.

stories.title: Maharashtra: Patient Rights Groups Flag Missing Safeguards In Proposed Hospital Law; Oppose Bill Ahead Of
stories.summary: A coalition of nearly 80 organisations across Maharashtra has opposed the removal of several existing patient safeguards and approached around 11 MLAs from different parts of the state to raise the issue during the upcoming winter session of the legislature. The coalition held a Patients' Rights Dialogue in Mumbai on Friday, attended by a large number of health activists and public representatives.

stories.title: Natural and Ayurvedic Ingredients for Hair Growth: Bhringraj, Rosemary, Amla and What the Evidence Says
stories.summary: Natural ingredients have long been part of hair care, with traditional practices continuing to shape how consumers approach hair fall and scalp health. From Bhringraj and amla in Ayurveda to rosemary in contemporary hair care conversations, several plant-based ingredients are gaining attention. However, understanding what the evidence actually supports is important when choosing a hair care routine.

stories.title: Health Dept. prepared to handle KFD cases in Shivamogga, says Khader
stories.summary: T. Khader has said that his department is equipped to prevent the spread of Kyasanur Forest Disease (KFD) in Shivamogga, and that a special ward with 10 beds has been set up in every taluk hospital in the district. Speaking at a review meeting in Shivamogga on Friday, the Minister said the department was prepared to handle any cases that might be reported.

stories.title: Plea to shift health sub-centre from Periyasholai to Yellamalai in Gudalur
stories.summary: The O’Valley Makkal Iyakkam, a community advocacy group in the Nilgiris, has appealed to the government to relocate the proposed health sub-centre from Periyasholai to Yellamalai in O’Valley town panchayat in Gudalur. In their letter to the government, R. Ranjith, co-ordinator of O’Valley Makkal Iyakkam, said that the health sub-centre is to be constructed at a cost of ₹55 lakh.

stories.title: Men's Health Awareness Month 2026 highlights why men delay check-ups; a physician warns that ignoring health can have dire consequences
stories.summary: Men often postpone routine health check-ups, sometimes until symptoms become severe enough to disrupt their daily lives. This behaviour is influenced by several factors, including busy work schedules, family responsibilities, fear of medical diagnoses, lack of awareness, and the belief that feeling physically fit means being healthy.

stories.title: Doctor explains the effects of winter beverage habits on kidney health, shares how best to enjoy them
stories.summary: A warm cup of tea, coffee or hot chocolate can be very comforting in chilly weather, but excessive consumption can affect kidney health, shares Dr Anupam Roy. As the winter chill sets in across the country, many people increase the consumption of their favourite hot beverage to deal with it.

stories.title: From choosing the wrong surgeon to unrealistic expectations: 7 hair transplant mistakes to watch out for
stories.summary: Unnatural hairlines and poor density can affect hair transplant results. Here are common mistakes to watch out for before opting for the procedure. A hair transplant is not merely a surgical exercise of relocating hair follicles from one part of the scalp to another.

stories.title: Food blogger prepares vegetarian chana sushi packed with 12g protein and only 260 calories
stories.summary: Kirti shares a simple, vegetarian sushi recipe that is low in calories but rich in protein and healthy fats, making it a guilt-free indulgent meal. Sushi is a dish that can be prepared in many ways, with the freshness of the ingredients and simplicity of preparation enhancing its flavours.

stories.title: Oncologist explains why pancreatic cancer is often difficult to spot early: When stomach discomfort is more than just acidity, prevention, diagnosis
stories.summary: Since pancreatic cancer can be difficult to detect early, oncologist Dr Surender explains why it is so, diagnosis, treatment, and more. ). In an interaction with HT Lifestyle, Dr Surender Kumar Dabas, chairman at Manipal Comprehensive Cancer Centre and Onco Robotic Surgeries, North-West Cluster, Manipal Hospitals, highlighted when stomach discomfort is more than just acidity, tips for prevention, diagnosis, treatment, and more.

stories.title: Bombay High Court gives go-ahead for Tata Sons board meeting on November 30
stories.summary: The Bombay High Court on Friday (November 27, 2026) refused urgent relief to two Tata Trusts challenging the casting voting rights of reappointed executive chairman N. Chandrasekaran, ruling that Tata Sons' November 30 board meeting can proceed as scheduled, subject to the High Court's final orders.

stories.title: Asian Champions Trophy: India outclass Malaysia, set up final against China
stories.summary: Defending champions India produced a commanding display to defeat Malaysia 6–2 in the semi-final of the women's Asian Champions Trophy at the International Sports Complex in Bhopal on Friday, securing their place in the final for a sixth time. Tournament's top scorer Deepika Sehrawat scored twice, while Mumtaz Khan, Navneet Kaur, Sunelita Toppo and Ishika found the mark once each.

stories.title: IPL 2027: Rohit Sharma back in the saddle for Mumbai Indians
stories.summary: Rohit Sharma, three years after being stripped of captaincy, has been reinstated as Mumbai Indians skipper for the Indian Premier League 2027, returning to the role in which he led the franchise to all five of its IPL titles. After trading Hardik Pandya, who led the side for three seasons, to Punjab Kings, Mumbai has turned to the man behind its most successful era.

stories.title: Day after India's exit, Pakistan book place in final of Rising Stars Asia Cup
stories.summary: Pakistan A will face Sri Lanka A in the final of the Rising Stars Asia Cup after the defending champions beat Bangladesh A by five wickets in the second semi-final in Doha on Friday. Hasan Nawaz, Shahzaib Khan and captain Abdul Samad played key roles in the chase as Pakistan hunted down a target of 233 with five wickets and 28 deliveries to spare.

stories.title: Syed Modi badminton: Unnati to clash with Tanvi in semi-final
stories.summary: The absence of India’s biggest badminton names may have robbed the Syed Modi India International of some star appeal, but the tournament is turning out to be rewarding for the country’s second rung. Young Indian shuttlers are making their presence felt, with Unnati Hooda and Tanvi Sharma ensuring an all-Indian women’s singles semi-final on Friday.

stories.title: ‘Nothing comes before our nation’: Khushbu Sundar backs Jo Bachay Hain Sang Samait Lo ban
stories.summary: Her remarks come amid controversy over the proposed release of the Netflix series, starring Fawad Khan and Mahira Khan. The Ministry of Information and Broadcasting has reminded Netflix that content originating in Pakistan must not be streamed in India and asked the platform to comply with its advisory issued on May 8, 2025.

stories.title: World chess championship: Sindarov admits Gukesh out-prepared him in third game
stories.summary: Challenger Javokhir Sindarov admitted he was out-prepared by defending champion D Gukesh in the third game of the World Chess Championship in Geneva, as the Indian's opening preparation put the Uzbek under pressure. 5 after three consecutive draws, Sindarov acknowledged that Gukesh, who was playing with Black pieces in Game 3, had caught him off guard with his preparation in the opening.

stories.title: Rohit Sharma's return as captain doesn't guarantee success for MI in IPL 2027: Ashwin
stories.summary: Rohit has reclaimed the leadership role after three seasons away from it , taking over from Hardik Pandya, who has moved to Punjab Kings in a trade involving Arshdeep Singh. The decision marks another change in Mumbai's leadership structure as the franchise looks to rediscover the success it enjoyed under Rohit.

stories.title: Shreyas Iyer to join Mumbai's squad for Super League phase of Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy
stories.summary: India’s T20I captain Shreyas Iyer will join Mumbai for the Super League stage of the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy, beginning in Nagpur on Monday. His arrival will strengthen an already formidable batting line-up, but Suryakumar Yadav will continue to lead the side. Shreyas has been training at the Brabourne Stadium over the last couple of days and will be available as Mumbai looks to extend its unbeaten streak.

stories.title: ISL: Trijoy's strike hands Churchill Brothers win over Inter Kashi
stories.summary: Churchill Brothers SC ended their four-match losing streak with a hard-fought 1-0 victory over Inter Kashi in the Indian Super League at the Shree Shiv Chhatrapati Sports Complex, in Pune, on Friday. Substitute Trijoy Dias (53') scored the winner in what was a feisty encounter as the Red Machines registered what was their first away win of the campaign.

stories.title: Cricket Australia gives players six weeks to share accounts of ball-tampering scandal
stories.summary: Cricket Australia (CA) has made public the terms of reference for its independent forum examining the events surrounding the controversial 2018 South Africa tour, which became infamous for the ball-tampering scandal. The board will instead receive a report summarising the key issues raised during the process, along with recommendations.

stories.title: Rohit Sharma back as Mumbai Indians captain ahead of IPL 2027
stories.summary: Almost three years after being removed from the post, Rohit Sharma has been reinstated as Mumbai Indians captain for IPL 2027, the franchise confirmed on Friday. Rohit, 39, replaces former skipper Hardik Pandya, who was traded to Punjab Kings for Arshdeep Singh earlier this month, as MI look to reclaim their former glory.

stories.title: Australia set to drop Lyon for first New Zealand Test
stories.summary: Cricket Correspondent Published 18 minutes ago Australia are set to drop off-spinner Nathan Lyon for the first Test against New Zealand, with uncapped Corey Rocchiccioli expected to be named in the squad. The omission of Lyon for the Test in Perth from 9-13 December is not thought to be linked to the sandpaper controversy.

stories.title: Fury cleared to fight Joshua after wife retracts schizophrenia claim
stories.summary: Tyson Fury has been medically cleared to fight Anthony Joshua in December after the bout was put in jeopardy by claims of a schizophrenia diagnosis. Fury, 38, spoke of his mental health struggles in a Netflix documentary which was released on Friday, with his wife, Paris, saying he had been diagnosed with schizophrenia.

stories.title: India makes case to IOC for hosting 2036 Olympics
stories.summary: The Indian Olympic Association (IOA) made the presentation during a virtual meeting on Thursday, outlining Ahmedabad's preparedness, the country's experience in hosting international sporting events, proposed venue development plans and the support extended by the city, Gujarat and the Union government. IOA president PT Usha, CEO Raghuram Iyer and PV Sindhu, chairperson of the IOA Athletes' Commission, represented India.

stories.title: Akash Deep Steals The Show As India Hit Back After New Zealand's Strong Start
stories.summary: Akash Deep emerged as India's standout bowler on the opening day of the second Test against New Zealand, producing two outstanding deliveries in the post-lunch session to overshadow even the impressive Jasprit Bumrah. After winning the toss and electing to bowl, India initially struggled to make inroads as New Zealand captain Tom Latham and Devon Conway put together a 77-run opening partnership.

stories.title: India A knocked out of Asia Cup Rising Stars after loss to Sri Lanka A in semis
stories.summary: A spirited Sri Lanka A rode on centuries from openers Lasith Croospulle (116) and Sineth Jayawardene (105) to decimate a star-studded India A by eight wickets and reach the Asia Cup Rising Stars final here on Thursday. Both Croospulle and Jayawardene received early reprieves in the form of dropped catches and made India A, which had several international cricketers at its disposal, rue those mistakes.

stories.title: WACT: India outclasses Malaysia, storms into the final; meets China
stories.summary: Deepika put on another masterclass in dragflicking as she led India into the final of the Women’s Asian Champions Trophy with a 6-2 win over Malaysia here at the International Sports Complex on Friday. India was ruthless from penalty corners, converting four of its first six attempts within the 33rd minute to pulverise the Malaysian defence and put the result beyond doubt.

stories.title: Bhavika Ahire, Uma Kashvi help India U-19 women beat England by 36 runs
stories.summary: Skipper Bhavika Ahire struck an unbeaten 63, while Uma Kashvi claimed 3/24 as India U-19 women's team beat England by 36 runs in the opening match of their five-match T20 series here on Thursday. Ahire smashed nine fours and two sixes in her 33-ball unbeaten knock, while Achsah Parmar clobbered three sixes and four boundaries to score 52 off 35 balls, powering India to 197 for five.

stories.title: MP Sports Roundup Sees Dhar Enter Cricket Final, Indore Shine Across Multiple Disciplines
stories.summary: Dhar (Madhya Pradesh): Batting brilliance met bowling firepower as Dhar stormed into the final of the Inter-District Senior Leather Ball Cricket Tournament, overcoming Khandwa by virtue of a crucial 26-run first-innings lead. Electing to bat first, Khandwa posted 189 runs, with Jaspal Singh contributing a fighting 69. However, Sunder Dhakad stole the bowling spotlight, claiming six wickets to keep the opposition in check.

stories.title: Pakistan Shaheens & Bangladesh A Players Offer Juma Prayers Together Before Rising Stars Asia Cup Semi-Final | VIDEO
stories.summary: In a beautiful moment at the Rising Stars Asia Cup, players from Pakistan Shaheens and Bangladesh A came together to offer Juma (Friday) prayers ahead of their semi-final match. The players from both teams put their cricket rivalry aside and stood together for prayers. Let us know! 👂 What type of content would you like to see from us this year?

stories.title: India Storm Into Hockey Final Against China, Korea Secure Fifth Spot In Bhopal
stories.summary: Bhopal (Madhya Pradesh): Six goals, a sparkling Deepika double and a golden date with destiny! Defending champions India stormed into the Women's Asian Champions Trophy final with a commanding 6-2 demolition of Malaysia at the International Sports Complex, Nathu Barkheda, on Friday.

stories.title: Head coach Slegers leaves Arsenal 18 months after Champions League win
stories.summary: Arsenal have parted company with head coach Renee Slegers by mutual consent after a disappointing start to the season. Slegers, 37, was initially appointed on an interim basis in October 2024 before being handed the role permanently three months later. The Dutchwoman led Arsenal to their second Women's Champions League title in May 2025 and the inaugural Fifa Women's Champions Cup in February 2026.

stories.title: MCA Women’s Cricket League 2026: Sadhvi Sanjay’s 113 Powers Glorious CC To 9-Run Win Over Matunga Gymkhana
stories.summary: Batting first, Glorious CC, boosted by Sadhvi's mammoth innings, piled up a big total of 298 for 3 wickets in 39 overs. Sadhvi received good support from Aarohi Bambode, who scored 80 runs, and Swara Jadhav, who made 40 runs, to lift the innings. Sanjam Natt picked up 3 wickets for 45 runs.

stories.title: 'He will win games single-handedly': Ex-cricketer backs Sooryavanshi for ODI World Cup
stories.summary: Impressed by the youngster's fearless approach, Srikkanth believes Sooryavanshi has the potential to become an all-format cricketer and should not be restricted to a particular format. Kris Srikkanth backs Vaibhav Sooryavanshi for 2027 ODI World CupSrikkanth believes Sooryavanshi deserves to be included in India's 15-member squad for the 2027 ODI World Cup, even if the team management is not yet convinced about his readiness for Test cricket.

stories.title: Lionel Messi reportedly moves to ban AFA from using his name and image
stories.summary: Lionel Messi is reportedly preparing legal action to prevent the Argentine Football Association (AFA) from commercially using his name and image, amid growing tensions with president Claudio Tapia. The rift stems from alleged financial irregularities, sponsor conflicts and separate legal disputes. The potential split could significantly affect the AFA’s commercial strategy, given Messi’s immense global appeal and marketing value.

stories.title: Mamata-led Trinamool Congress questions legality of rebel MPs voting on delimitation bill amid pending defection case
stories.summary: Will the 20 Lok Sabha MPs elected on Trinamool Congress tickets, who later switched to the little-known Nationalist Citizens Party of India (NCPI), be allowed to vote when the Constitutional Amendment Bills come up for consideration in the Lok Sabha? The Mamata Banerjee-led faction of the party asked on Friday (November 27, 2026).

stories.title: Do Indian bodies burn calories differently? Country’s 1st advanced metabolic chamber seeks answers
stories.summary: The Human Metabolic Chamber at Vellore’s Christian Medical College (CMC) was jointly established by the college and the Tata Institute of Fundamental Research’s (TIFR) Advanced Research Unit on Metabolism, Development and Aging (ARUMDA) and is designed to give researchers a more precise picture of how the human body burns calories and uses different sources of energy.

stories.title: Spain’s 2026 election explained in maps and charts
stories.summary: google Add Al Jazeera on Spain will hold a snap election on November 29 that could bring the far right into government for the first time since the end of Francisco Franco’s dictatorship in 1975.

stories.title: On what legal basis has government blocked a Pakistani series on Netflix? | Explained
stories.summary: The Pakistani series Jo Bachay Hain Sang Samait Lo , starring Fawad Khan, Hania Aamir, Mahira Khan, Sanam Saeed and Ahad Raza Mir, has become the target of an online furore.

stories.title: Mint explainer: why HPV vaccination is critical for girls as India crosses 10 million doses
stories.summary: India has administered more than 10 million doses of the human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine to 14-year-old girls in less than nine months under a campaign by the Union health ministry. The drive has covered nearly 87% of the annual target cohort of about 12 million girls, drawing praise from the World Health Organization’s (WHO) South-East Asia Region.

stories.title: Explained: What is ‘Starmind’? SpaceX gets FCC nod for 1 million space-based data centres - Full details
stories.summary: SpaceX has received approval from the US Federal Communications Commission (FCC) to deploy up to 1 million orbital computing modules for a proposed constellation of space-based data centres, marking a major push to take artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure beyond Earth.

stories.title: Why did Georgian police clash with Turkish football fans over Palestine?
stories.summary: google Add Al Jazeera on Police in Georgia have detained at least 16 people following clashes between football fans at a game between Turkish and Israeli clubs. The Europa League fifth round match between Turkiye’s Besiktas and Israel’s Hapoel Be’er Sheva was hosted in Georgia instead of Turkiye.

stories.title: Explainer-Spain’s snap election — why it matters and who might win?
stories.summary: MADRID, Nov 26 (Reuters) – Spain goes to the polls on Sunday in an early parliamentary election that may usher in a right-wing coalition to replace the Socialist-led minority government of Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez, one of Europe’s last leftist leaders. Sanchez called the election after parliament on October 2 rejected his decrees to address growing anger over rising rents and evictions.

stories.title: Are you damaging your hair in the name of haircare? The problem with viral DIY treatments
stories.summary: Social media has transformed the haircare landscape, but it has also created a paradox: people have access to more information than ever, yet distinguishing scientific evidence from popular opinion has become harder than ever. The industry is witnessing a growing culture of quick fixes, where viral remedies, trending ingredients, and DIY treatments are often presented as universal solutions to complex hair and scalp concerns.

stories.title: Who is Nelson Dilipkumar's father Samson? Actor Vincent Roy shares interesting details about 'Jailer 2' d
stories.summary: Director Nelson Dilipkumar is popular for his style of narration and humor in Tamil films. Although many people know his films and journey as a director, not many know about his father, Samson, and his association with the literary world. This is because actor Vincent Roy has revealed some information about him in an interview.

stories.title: Is Venezuela a new-age American colony? | The View from India podcast
stories.summary: S. capture of Nicolás Maduro has opened a new chapter in Venezuela’s political crisis. With Delcy Rodríguez at the helm and Washington seeking greater influence over the country’s oil sector and political future, questions remain over who really holds power in Caracas. What does Donald Trump want from Venezuela?

stories.title: 'Bomb Se Uda Denge?': Diljit Dosanjh Turns Mumbai Concert Bomb Threat Into A Message Of Love, Says 'Shehron Mein Baroodon Ka Mausam Hai' - VIDEO
stories.summary: Singer and actor Diljit Dosanjh has reacted to the bomb threat reported at Mumbai's Mahalaxmi Racecourse, where he is scheduled to perform. Addressing the threat, Diljit said that he had nothing but love to offer, despite the threats being made against the concert. Diljit Dosanjh's official social media handle shared a video from his Mumbai concert, in which the singer addressed the bomb threat in his trademark style.

stories.title: Diljit Dosanjh Mumbai concert: Fans stand in long queues outside venue well before gates open
stories.summary: Tonight, the vibrant Diljit Dosanjh will light up Mahalaxmi Racecourse in Mumbai with his much-anticipated performance. Due to a bomb threat, authorities are on high alert, increasing security to keep concert-goers safe. Fans are buzzing outside, excitedly preparing for the show while complying with safety protocols. After Mumbai, the Aura India Tour will continue to Bengaluru on November 29, 2026, as audiences remain thrilled amidst the heightened safety awareness.

stories.title: 'Deepam to be lit tomorrow': Furious SC suspends temple trust, asks CRPF to step in
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has mandated that a Karthigai Deepam lamp be lit atop Deepathoon, following the suspension of the temple's board of trustees and the appointment of receivers for management. Security responsibilities have been given to the CRPF for the temple and nearby hill. Moreover, the court issued contempt notices to several Tamil Nadu officials for non-compliance and cautioned against any actions that might threaten constitutional order.
